nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: What this is, and isn't
nodes.rationale: Fixed ~1200x800 wall-tablet-landscape sizing is a deliberate constraint, not a bug; columns size tiles to content and scroll internally rather than stretching, and the mobile page is a secondary, complete layout designed after the wall-tablet decisions.

nodes.label: Via HACS (recommended)
nodes.rationale: HACS installs always land in config/www/community/live_dashboard/, so name: must be exactly live_dashboard-panel to match the folder the panel element derives its tag from; getting it wrong produced a silent black screen, now surfaced as an explicit console.error and on-page message naming expected vs actual folder.

nodes.label: Migrating between manual and HACS installs
nodes.rationale: module_url and name: differ between manual and HACS installs; the side-by-side casa/casa2 pattern is manual-only because HACS always fixes the folder to live_dashboard, so carrying over a custom name: is the most common cause of a mismatched panel tag.
nodes.norm_label: migrating between manual and hacs installs

nodes.label: Settings panel (gear icon, v1.5.0)
nodes.rationale: config.js keeps sole authority over resolving which sensor plays which role; the settings panel only ever layers visibility on top, per-user via HA account storage, so the two never conflict — a row overridden against config.js shows a 'differs from config.js' pill to revert.

nodes.label: Energy sensor role mapping table (Huawei/SolarEdge/Fronius/Shelly EM/HA)
nodes.rationale: Sensors are requested by role, not by brand, so any integration exposing the right device_class/state_class works; roles without a native daily counter can be backed by a utility_meter helper.
nodes.norm_label: energy sensor role mapping table (huawei/solaredge/fronius/shelly em/ha)

nodes.label: Reading the ring
nodes.rationale: Replaces the old single-ring design (productionToday vs gridToday, two numbers that never summed to anything meaningful) with two concentric rings that each genuinely sum to 100% of a real quantity: consumption and production, sharing autoconsumo as the common drawn segment.

nodes.label: Enabling Irrigation
nodes.rationale: Agronomic math (ET0/ETc, accumulated deficit) is deliberately out of scope — it depends on the installer's own weather station/soil data and personal automations not included in this project.

nodes.label: Vehicle (optional)
nodes.rationale: No HA domain standardizes car telemetry, so config.vehicle is an explicit field-by-field mapping; tested with Mercedes mbapi2020 but not brand-specific.

nodes.label: Appliances (optional)
nodes.rationale: powerSwitch never drives the running/idle state shown because a device can stay powered between cycles; it only adds an off button, and the switch stops being auto-discovered separately to avoid appearing twice.

nodes.label: Cameras (optional)
nodes.rationale: Only works over panel_custom because snapshot/stream URLs are HA-signed and same-origin with the panel; a future standalone/token variant would need to handle that differently.

nodes.label: Kiosk mode for the wall tablet
nodes.norm_label: kiosk mode for the wall tablet

nodes.label: Known limits
nodes.rationale: Everything is sourced from HA's own area/device/entity registries with no fallback naming/grouping; an install with unassigned areas looks empty by design, not a bug — that is HA's Settings -> Areas waiting to be filled in.

nodes.label: module_url version cache-busting (?v=X.Y.Z)
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and browsers cache ES modules aggressively, so a plain hard refresh doesn't reliably force a re-fetch of panel.js; the version query param must be bumped manually on every update.

nodes.label: Settings -> Diagnostica panel
nodes.rationale: Named because most users run this on a companion app/wall tablet where console.log is inaccessible, so end-user-facing diagnostics need an in-app equivalent.

nodes.label: Cos'è, e cosa non è
nodes.rationale: Dimensione fissa ~1200x800 per tablet a muro orizzontale è un vincolo voluto; le colonne dimensionano le tessere sul contenuto e scorrono internamente invece di stirarsi.

nodes.label: Via HACS (consigliato)
nodes.rationale: name: deve corrispondere esattamente a live_dashboard-panel perché il pannello si registra sotto <cartella>-panel, e sotto HACS la cartella è sempre live_dashboard; un errore ora produce un messaggio esplicito invece dello schermo nero.

nodes.label: Pannello impostazioni (ingranaggio, v1.5.0)
nodes.rationale: config.js resta l'unica autorità per risolvere quale sensore fa quale ruolo; il pannello decide solo cosa è visibile, sopra quello — evitando conflitti tra i due meccanismi.

nodes.label: Come si legge l'anello
nodes.rationale: Sostituisce il vecchio anello singolo (produzione vs prelievo, numeri che non sommavano a nulla) con due anelli che sommano ciascuno al 100% di una quantità reale.

nodes.label: Attivare l'Irrigazione
nodes.rationale: La parte agronomica (ET0/ETc, deficit accumulato) non fa parte del progetto: dipende da stazione meteo e dati di suolo personali, non inclusi.

nodes.label: Telecamere (opzionale)
nodes.rationale: Funziona solo su panel_custom perché gli URL di snapshot/stream sono firmati da HA e same-origin col pannello.

nodes.label: Modalità kiosk per il tablet a muro
nodes.norm_label: modalita kiosk per il tablet a muro

nodes.label: Limiti noti
nodes.rationale: Tutto viene dai registri area/dispositivo/entità di HA senza logica di fallback; un'installazione senza aree assegnate appare vuota per design, non è un bug.
